item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect lows from the lower thirties to the mid-thirties across the region under mostly cloudy to overcast skies, with widespread rain and some areas seeing a mix of rain and snow and rainfall totals ranging from about a quarter inch to as much as one inch. Tomorrow, highs will reach from the mid-forties to the lower fifties with cloudy to mostly cloudy skies and periods of rain or rain showers likely, especially late morning through the evening, bringing additional rainfall amounts generally under a half inch. Tomorrow night, lows will be in the lower to upper thirties with cloudy skies and rain showers continuing for most areas.
